title: Man Throws His Mother To The Ground Then Gets Tased After Charging Officer
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Gwinnett County, Georgia — On March 15, 2026, Gwinnett Police were dispatched to a call where it was reported that a male had pushed his mother, was yelling at her, and pulled another person’s hair out. When Officer R. Carrillo-Julian arrived, he made contact with 31-year-old Kehma Johnson, who stated he had just smoked weed. Johnson was acting erratically, making odd statements, and then suddenly charged Ofc. Carrillo-Julian. He was tased, and Ofc. Carrillo-Julian was able to gain control of him until backup arrived. Johnson continued to fight officers all the way to the jail. Officers located Johnson’s elderly mother inside the home and had her evaluated by Gwinnett County Fire and Emergency Services due to Johnson brutally assaulting her. They also made contact with the neighbor, who had a portion of her hair pulled out by Johnson. Johnson was charged with Aggravated Battery, False Imprisonment, Battery, Obstructing or Hindering Persons Making Emergency Telephone Call, and Willful Obstruction of Law Enforcement Officers by Use of Threats or Violence (Felony).
